trust_decision.summary: A search hit is trusted because strings.HasPrefix(node.Parent, user.BasePath) says so, and the handler returns the backend's unfiltered hit count; the same raw string-prefix trust is repeated on share create/update, and the shared-path unwrap helper does no read-time revalidation of the creator's (reloaded) BasePath.

landing_point.why: The advisory title names the Bleve search path check, so an engineer first reads the handler loop that drops hits with strings.HasPrefix(node.Parent, user.BasePath) and then returns the backend's raw page and raw Total.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A solver can argue that re-validating a creator's current BasePath inside the sharing unwrap helper is a different feature from the Bleve search prefix bug, and that the raw file list a multi-file share shows at its root was chosen by the creator, so a later admin base-path change is configuration, not this advisory.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A user must still reach and share their own base path exactly: hits whose Parent equals user.BasePath (files sitting directly in the base folder) and a share whose file equals the base path must stay visible. A naive fix that requires a separator, e.g. HasPrefix(s, user.BasePath+"/"), hides the base folder itself and makes search return nothing at the base root; the equality arm of utils.IsSubPath (pkg/utils/path.go:43) is what keeps both working (same shape at server/handles/search.go:54).

O6_input_shapes: string-prefix sibling without a separator: base /data vs hit parent /database (the bug)
exact equality: base /data vs hit parent /data, which must still pass
multi-element files array in one create/update request (every element must be checked, not just the first)
un-normalised paths (backslashes, //, '.', '..', trailing slash) on both sides of the comparison
hit directly in the requested parent vs hit in a deep subfolder of it (subtree, not equality)
pagination shapes: page>1, per_page smaller or larger than the visible result set, and per_page above the 1000-document batch with duplicate sort names on the batch boundary

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Multi-file sharing root listing: POST/GET /api/fs/list with path /@s{sid} enumerates sharing.Files element by element and never calls GetSharingUnwrapPath, so the creator-BasePath revalidation added by the fix does not apply to it
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: it only lists the paths the creator declared when the share was made, and the base-path change was an admin action on a different feature
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: 2 packages from server/handles (server/handles -> internal/sharing/list.go:70), a file and package the fix never touched

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a new caller of op.CreateSharing / op.UpdateSharing (share import, bulk create, bootstrap) that skips the handler-level BasePath check
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the check lives only in the HTTP handlers (server/handles/sharing.go:464,548); the op-layer create/update accepts any Files slice, so a maintainer adding an import or bulk route would naturally call op directly

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second walk over sharing.Files (download-all, share summary/manifest, torrent export) that maps each path without GetSharingUnwrapPath
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the multi-file root listing already copies this pattern, so a new sharing feature would copy it again

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a backend-native SearchFiltered in the meilisearch searcher that reuses the existing page/hits-per-page query and TotalHits and forgets the requested-parent / base-path filter
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the fix makes SearchFiltered an optional capability that each backend is expected to implement, and this backend already returns an unfiltered TotalHits

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an admin-on-behalf share creation path (req.CreatorName) that the loop skips because reqUser.IsAdmin()
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: that exempt branch already exists, and the fix only catches the result at read time
